items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Joe Dantzburg and I started them out.

ctx.x: That's right, that's right. When did you start using the hi-hat or sock cymbal, what do you call that hi-hat or sock cymbal? That's a hi-hat cymbal. I thought well I got modern just like everybody else did, you know.

In the late years you know I had to follow a style too. That's what I said the other night when you hear, I'm doing a lot of things twenty years ago I don't think I had to do it. But I have to keep up, because if I had to stay like I was I never got no job. No, I've changed a little myself, but I still try to keep that. Same beat. And I played with a bunch of boys out here. One of the boys is a trombone player, he works out there with Waltz Living Studio. You see Ward Kimball, I don't know if you've ever heard of…
